title: Hire charges for boat of length of 50' and above including dingy for trip "Agatti - Suhelipar - Valiyakkara - Agatti"
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations from registered Lakshadweep boat owners for hiring a 50 ft or longer boat with dinghy for DLL staff trips from Agatti Island to Suhelipar/Cheriyakara and Valiyakkara Islands and back, for lighthouse maintenance (Kochi Directorate); one-year contract extendable by two years.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Agatti Island / Agatti Lighthouse
sites.work: Trip start/end point; quotation forms issued and submitted to Station In-charge

sites.name: Suhelipar
sites.work: Boat trip destination with night stay for DLL maintenance staff

sites.name: Valiyakkara
sites.work: Boat trip destination for DLL maintenance staff

scope.item: Boat trip Agatti Island to Cheriyakara/Suhelipar, Valiyakkara and back (including 1 night stay), boat 50 ft and above with dinghy, fuel, crew (min. 4), VHF, GPS, life-saving appliances
Halting charge (additional night) including provision for food rations/fresh water
Food charges per official per day (3 times), for 04 to 09 DLL officials per trip

money.performance_security: Performance Bank Guarantee Rs 10,000 (DD/FDR from nationalised/RBI approved bank, payable at Ernakulam) within 10 days of award, valid for contract period + 60 days
money.notes: Rates to be quoted separately for 1st, 2nd and 3rd year, all-inclusive (fuel, oil, lubes, crew, dinghy); no mobilisation charges; no escalation. TDS 1% (individual/proprietor) or 2% (firm/company); 20% if PAN not linked with Aadhaar. Director may empanel more than one provider at L1 rates.

period.completion: Contract initially 1 year, extendable by another 2 years on yearly basis

eligibility: Registered boat owners in UT of Lakshadweep
Valid registration and certificate for operation of boats; layout plan, specifications and survey/classification certificates to be furnished
Boat length 50 ft and above with dinghy; canopy, wheel house with bed, life jackets, life buoys, anchor, fire extinguishers, first aid box, wash room; VHF and GPS
Crew with experience visiting Suhelipar/Cheriyakara/Valiyakkara islands; minimum 4 crew on board
Valid PAN (linked with Aadhaar), GST registration and bank account details
specs: Boat of length 50 ft and above, accompanied by dinghy
VHF radio, GPS, life jackets and high-quality life-saving appliances
Minimum two days at Cheriyakara/Suhelipar/Valiyakkara for maintenance activities; embarkation/disembarkation from department vessels MV Sagar Deep II and MV Indira Point when required

corrigenda.change: Corrigendum II: last date for sealed quotations extended to 04.12.2025 17:00; quotations may be submitted to Station In-charge Agatti Lighthouse / Kavaratti Lighthouse or to the Director, DLL Kochi

notes: Original NIQ dated 03.11.2025: forms 04.11.2025 to 19.11.2025, submission by 19.11.2025 17:00. Corrigendum II references a Corrigendum (I) dated 19.11.2025 that is not among the listing documents. T&C clause 27 gives a stale contact window 23.10.2024 to 02.11.2024 (likely copied from a previous year). Annexure-I asks for owner's name and mobile number (form field only). No estimate or EMD printed.
